_note: Each prompt is sent to Claude, ChatGPT (OpenAI API) and Gemini with no system prompt and default settings, like a normal chat user. Topics mirror the human sample set. variant 'plain' = normal request (used for calibration). variant 'humanized' = the user asks the model to sound human (reported separately, not used for anchors).

prompts.prompt: Why can't planes fly through big clouds? Like what actually happens to a plane inside a thunderstorm cloud?
How does wifi actually work? What's the difference between 2.4 and 5 GHz and why does my wifi get worse in some rooms?
What is stoicism really about? Is it just about not showing emotions?
Why do some vaccines get combined into one shot and others don't?
Did people in the middle ages understand economics at all? Like inflation and stuff?

Write an email to a coworker in accounting asking them to clarify how a monthly agency fee should be calculated. We use the higher of receipts vs deliveries, but I'm not sure whether to use the nominated volume or the actual volume. Last month we left it at the nomination of 45,000/day, but this month actuals are 47,089/day.

Write a short email apologizing to a colleague named John. Someone told him I said he promised the Fort Pierce lateral pipeline would be included in the next expansion phase. I never said that and I know he always said it would be hard to get approved.

Write an email to our HR legal contact Michelle. We want to rescind a job offer for a candidate who already signed the offer letter but hasn't started yet (start date December 28). The hiring manager now thinks the role is non-essential. Ask how we should handle it.

Write an email to a former executive I worked for. The company is going through a hard time and I'll probably have to leave soon. Remind him of the big client deals I led, and ask if he would refer me to a couple of senior executive recruiters. Also say I'd like to shake his hand before I go.

Write an email to everyone in the Portland office saying we're selling old computer monitors: older 17 inch for $10, newer 17 inch for $20, older 21 inch for $25, newer 19 inch for $35. Reply to request one, we'll do a lottery Friday morning, and anything not picked up by next Friday gets donated.
